_comment: Deployment record for the v2.1.1 OIV cross-chain infra (SALT V3). Deployed EOA-owned, configured (mainnet selector registry seeded), then ownership transferred to the OIV Safe. The three `canonical` contracts share one address on every chain (deterministic CREATE2, salt v3, eoaOwner 0xAa5A...4F72); `emptyContract` is unchanged from earlier salts. `chains[]` = the 19 deployed chains (FINAL set). `excluded[]` = chains deliberately not pursued. SALT V3 supersedes salt v2 (factory 0xfff31e9948E2afF718Ca0f80C349ebE90F50f965): v2 predates the MultiSend unwrap-adapter fix, so any fund deployed through it gets Roles Modifiers that reject batched multiSend calls. A fund must NOT straddle two factory versions - the factory address is baked into the Avatar Safe setup() initializer, so the same salt yields different Safe addresses across versions. BUILD NOTE: foundry.toml leaves bytecode_hash at its solc default, so these addresses depend on the build environment (dependency source PATHS are hashed into the metadata); they were produced from a fresh `git clone --recurse-submodules` of main at 9120f63 and are pinned by test/FactoryAddressSync.t.sol. Human companion: docs/DEPLOYED_ADDRESSES.md.

canonical._comment: Same address on every chain (deterministic CREATE2, salt v3). owner()==finalOwner (Safe) post-handover, verified on-chain on all 19.

mainnetSelectorRegistry._comment: Seeded from the EOA BEFORE ownership moved to the Safe. A salt-v3 orchestrator starts EMPTY - the v2 registry does not carry over. The seeding script initially wrote 20 entries because bob+katana are verdict READY-AFTER-EMPTY; both were removed via removeChainSelector while the EOA still owned the orchestrator. script/CcipDeployEverywhere.s.sol now honours an `excluded` flag so this cannot recur (test/SelectorSeedScope.t.sol).

verification.status: Salt-v3 explorer verification, 2026-07-24/25. All 19 chains verified on at least FOUR independent backends (Sourcify v2 57/57, Etherscan V2 51/51 on its 17 chains, Blockscout 30/30, Routescan 15/15 on its 5 chains, Tenderly 54/57 public). OKLink is indeterminate due to IP rate-limiting and adds no coverage that is not already held. Every figure was confirmed by a READ (getsourcecode / is_verified / Sourcify contract lookup / Routescan getabi), never from a forge exit code.

sourcifyV2._comment: Keyless, exact_match, and the lead backend: it auto-propagated to Etherscan/Routescan/Blockscout, which is why the later Etherscan sweep found everything 'already verified'.

etherscanV2._comment: 17 chains support Etherscan V2. scroll (534352) and ink (57073) are NOT on V2 - covered by Blockscout instead. This also lights up the branded UIs (Basescan, Arbiscan, Lineascan, HyperEVMScan, SonicScan, ...) since they share the same DB.

blockscout._comment: 10 instances x 3 contracts. NOTE: scroll.blockscout.com now 301-redirects to scrollscan.com - a read that does not follow redirects reports a false gap.

routescan._comment: Populated via Sourcify propagation. 15/15 for the five chains Routescan actually hosts; the others are simply not Routescan networks.

tenderly._comment: PUBLIC verify in the karpatkey/agents project (always public - see the /verify-contracts skill). hyperevm (999) is not a supported Tenderly network, which is structural, not a gap.

oklink._comment: OKLink verification is KEYLESS (an OKX trading API key does NOT work here - it returns Invalid OK-ACCESS-KEY; that credential is for a different product). Submissions went in for all 27 targets. 7 are confirmed Success; the rest could not be confirmed in-session because OKLink throttled the submit route (code 50026) and a guid - the only status handle - is obtainable only from a submit. The check-verify-result route itself is keyless and unthrottled. Tracked in issue #39; re-run script/verify/oklink_patient.py from a cooled-down IP to settle it. Re-submitting an already-verified contract is safe.
oklink.result: submitted on all 9 OKLink chains (27 targets); >=7 confirmed Success, remainder pending OKLink-side confirmation
oklink.impact: None on coverage: every chain OKLink serves is already verified on Sourcify v2 + Etherscan V2 (or Blockscout for scroll) + Tenderly.

supersededSaltV2._comment: Still on-chain on all 19 chains but ABANDONED - predates the MultiSend unwrap-adapter fix. Do not deploy funds through it.
